text:
Lena (Partnerships): quick roundup: marketplace launch target Fri Jun 6. need partner logos, approved one-line quotes, demo video, and SI integration checklist by Tue EOD. who picks what?
Ava (Marketing): I can own press + blog. will draft co-authored blog template now. need quotes by Tue noon to finalize.
Ravi (Design): will create hero and partner mosaic. ask partners for SVG+clearspace rules. also need a 1280x720 thumbnail for the demo.
Oliver (Eng): I'll prepare the "Listing Quickstart" and a sample payload for SI partners. can mark listings as "private_preview" for partners during validation.
Priya (Legal): logos need usage forms signed. no quotes public until legal signoff. I'll send the checklist and track approvals.
Diego (PM): note: hardware partner (NodeEdge) requires SKU mapping in the catalog. Lena, can you confirm SKU owner?
Lena (Partnerships): confirming NodeEdge will provide SKU list by Mon. I'll chase partners for sample payloads.
announcebot: reminder scheduled: "Assets due Tue 12:00" -> pings Ava and Lena if not uploaded.
Ava (Marketing): social copy will include utm_campaign=marketplace-jun. will leave quote placeholders.
Oliver (Eng): demo video notes: please capture the SI install flow and the private_preview toggle. send a short script and I'll produce a sanitized recording.
Priya (Legal): quick check: any partner wanting a "Powered by" badge needs a signed brand form.
Ravi (Design): sharing Figma link in thread in a sec.
Lena (Partnerships): owners recap: Press - Ava; Quotes/Logos - Partners->Lena; Legal - Priya; Design - Ravi; Integration docs - Oliver; Release gating - Oliver/Diego. reconvene Wed 10am if any blockers. react with :thumbsup: when you own your item.
